root_problem: Operations specialists miss merchant onboarding handoffs because checklist status is split across spreadsheets and account tools, causing delayed launch readiness and repeated configuration questions.

user_profile.scenario: reviewing new merchant applications and preparing account configuration
user_profile.current_workaround: track checklist status in spreadsheets and copy settings between tools
user_profile.workaround_cost: 4 missed onboarding handoffs per month, delayed launch readiness, and repeated configuration questions

business_goals: reduce missed merchant onboarding handoffs from 4 per month to zero during the first 30-day observation window
make approved merchant setup status visible before operations starts account configuration handoff

appetite.complexity_ceiling: reuse existing approval and configuration systems
appetite.trim_first: advanced analytics and self-service rule builders

scope_boundaries: identify approved merchant applications from the existing approval system
show one onboarding handoff queue for operations specialists
record whether configuration ownership has been accepted
non_goals: do not replace the merchant CRM in this phase
do not build self-service approval rule builders
do not build cross-merchant onboarding analytics

feasibility_constraints.constraint: reuse the existing merchant account service and approval status model
feasibility_constraints.handling: limit Director scope to workflow baseline and configuration handoff

risks_and_unknowns.item: merchant category approval rule variance reviewed for the onboarding baseline
risks_and_unknowns.impact: confirmed categories do not require a separate Director phase split
risks_and_unknowns.mitigation: keep the single onboarding phase; return to risk review if category rules change the Director baseline

decision_rationale.choice: focus phase-1 on intake review and account configuration handoff
decision_rationale.rationale: this closes the slowest manual loop before investing in advanced automation
decision_rationale.excluded_options: full CRM replacement or rule builder in phase-1

delivery_plan.goal: deliver a guided merchant onboarding baseline
